title: Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Cross-Language Code Translation: Phenomena and Mitigation
title_zh: 大语言模型在跨语言代码翻译中的幻觉现象与缓解方法

paragraphs.en: Code translation converts source code from one programming language to another while preserving its functionality. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved code translation, their outputs still contain hallucinations: generated code that conflicts with the source program, violates target-language facts, or introduces contextually inconsistent dependencies. These failures are especially harmful in translation because small semantic deviations can silently change program behavior. Existing hallucination studies mainly focus on natural-language generation or code generation, leaving the forms, distribution, and mitigation of hallucinations in cross-language code translation insufficiently characterized. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of LLM hallucinations in code translation. Across three benchmark datasets, six language pairs, and seven LLMs, we construct a taxonomy with three major categories: Semantic Consistency Conflicts, Factual Knowledge Conflicts, and Project Context Deviations. We manually annotate 13,919 hallucination cases and analyze how hallucination types vary across models, datasets, and language directions. Guided by the taxonomy, we further propose HaluCodeTran, a mitigation framework that combines BM25-based retrieval of relevant translation examples with taxonomy-aware reflective refinement. The study provides an execution-tested characterization of code-translation hallucinations and a practical baseline for building more reliable LLM-based code migration tools.

paragraphs.en: Code translation, also known as source-to-source compilation or transpilation, involves converting code from one programming language to another while preserving its original functionality. This technique plays a critical role in modern software development. For example, many industries spend hundreds of millions of dollars to convert code written in older programming languages (e.g., FORTRAN and COBOL) to newer ones (e.g., Java, C++) ( Roziere et al., 2020 ) . By translating code into modern programming languages, organizations can reduce maintenance costs, improve reliability, and enhance non-functional attributes like security and performance ( Pan et al., 2024 ) . Automatic code translation can alleviate the burden of program migration and facilitate the development of software systems, which has drawn sustained attention from neural, LLM-based, and project-scale migration research ( Rozière et al., 2020 ; Ahmad et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Macedo et al., 2025 ) . Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved code translation and code-generation capabilities, while also raising new concerns about correctness, calibration, and domain-specific reliability ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Spiess et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 代码翻译，也称为源到源编译或转译，是指将代码从一种编程语言转换为另一种编程语言，同时保留其原有功能。 这一技术在现代软件开发中发挥着关键作用。 例如，许多行业花费数亿美元将用较旧编程语言（如 FORTRAN 和 COBOL）编写的代码转换为较新的语言（如 Java、C++）( Roziere et al., 2020 ) 。 通过将代码翻译为现代编程语言，组织可以降低维护成本、提高可靠性，并增强安全性和性能等非功能属性 ( Pan et al., 2024 ) 。 自动代码翻译可以减轻程序迁移的负担并促进软件系统的开发，因而持续受到神经模型、基于大语言模型以及项目级迁移研究的关注 ( Rozière et al., 2020 ; Ahmad et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Macedo et al., 2025 ) 。 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展提升了代码翻译和代码生成能力，同时也引发了对正确性、校准以及特定领域可靠性的新担忧 ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Spiess et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) 。

paragraphs.en: However, the translation quality of current LLM-driven approaches is still unsatisfactory, partly because generated programs can contain hallucinations: code fragments that conflict with source-program requirements, violate target-language facts, or introduce contextually inconsistent dependencies. These hallucinations can lead to functional errors, incomprehensible code, deprecated or misused APIs, and security vulnerabilities, undermining the reliability of translated codebases ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ) . Most existing hallucination research focuses on Natural Language Generation (NLG) tasks, such as question answering ( Sadat et al., 2023 ) and summarization ( Rehman et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2023 ) . Recent software-engineering studies have begun to characterize hallucinations, code-generation errors, and API misuse in LLM-based programming tasks ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ) , but code translation introduces a different failure surface. Unlike intent-to-code generation, code translation must preserve a structured source program while mapping syntax, types, libraries, APIs, and idioms into a different target language. A generated program may compile and still violate the source semantics, while a superficially small API or data-flow mismatch can completely change behavior. This makes hallucination in code translation a distinct empirical object rather than a direct instance of natural-language or code-generation hallucination.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前基于大语言模型的方法的翻译质量仍不令人满意，部分原因在于生成的程序可能包含幻觉：即与源程序需求冲突、违反目标语言事实或引入上下文不一致依赖的代码片段。 这些幻觉可能导致功能性错误、难以理解的代码、弃用或误用的API以及安全漏洞，从而损害翻译后代码库的可靠性（Pan et al., 2024；Tian et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2025a；Zhuo et al., 2026）。 现有的大多数幻觉研究集中于自然语言生成（NLG）任务，例如问答（Sadat et al., 2023）和摘要（Rehman et al., 2024；Ji et al., 2023）。 最近的软件工程研究已开始刻画基于大语言模型的编程任务中的幻觉、代码生成错误和API误用（Liu et al., 2024；Tian et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b；Lee et al., 2025；Zhuo et al., 2026），但代码翻译引入了不同的失效面。 与从意图生成代码不同，代码翻译必须在将语法、类型、库、API和惯用法映射到另一种目标语言的同时，保留结构化的源程序。 生成的程序可能可以编译通过，却仍然违反源程序语义，而表面上微小的API或数据流不匹配也可能完全改变程序行为。 这使得代码翻译中的幻觉成为一个独特的经验研究对象，而非自然语言幻觉或代码生成幻觉的直接实例。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we conduct an empirical study focused on hallucinations in cross-language code translation. Through open coding and empirical validation, we develop a taxonomy of code translation hallucinations, categorizing errors into three main types: (1) Semantic Consistency Conflicts (e.g., functional requirement mismatches, data inconsistencies), (2) Factual Knowledge Conflicts (e.g., syntax errors, incorrect library/API usage), (3) Project Context Deviations (e.g., dead code, dependency conflicts). We instantiate this taxonomy on outputs from seven LLMs, including GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) and Qwen 2.5-Coder ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , over three widely used code translation datasets: CodeNet ( Puri et al., 2021 ) , Avatar ( Ahmad et al., 2023 ) , and Transcoder ( Rozière et al., 2020 ) . The resulting annotations provide a basis for analyzing which hallucination categories dominate code translation failures and which model/language-pair conditions make them more likely.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥补这一空白，我们开展了一项聚焦于跨语言代码翻译中幻觉现象的实证研究。 通过开放编码与实证验证，我们构建了一个代码翻译幻觉的分类体系，将错误归纳为三种主要类型：(1) 语义一致性冲突（例如功能需求不匹配、数据不一致）、(2) 事实性知识冲突（例如语法错误、库/API 使用不当）、(3) 项目上下文偏差（例如死代码、依赖冲突）。 我们将该分类体系应用于七个大语言模型的输出，包括 GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) 和 Qwen 2.5-Coder ( Yang et al., 2024a ) ，并覆盖三个广泛使用的代码翻译数据集：CodeNet ( Puri et al., 2021 ) 、Avatar ( Ahmad et al., 2023 ) 和 Transcoder ( Rozière et al., 2020 ) 。 由此得到的标注为分析哪些幻觉类别主导代码翻译失败、以及哪些模型/语言对条件更容易引发这些幻觉提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Guided by the taxonomy, we propose HaluCodeTran, a mitigation framework that combines retrieval-based contextual grounding with reflective iterative refinement. The retrieval component provides relevant source-target translation examples to reduce factual and idiomatic uncertainty, while the reflection component asks the model to inspect the intermediate translation against the source program and taxonomy categories before producing a revision. On CodeNet, HaluCodeTran improves computational accuracy by up to 23 percentage points and reduces hallucination cases by up to 32% compared with vanilla translation, outperforming Chain-of-Thought, Chain-of-Verification, and Retrieval-Augmentation in average accuracy for the evaluated models.

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们总结我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We define hallucination in code translation and establish a taxonomy that distinguishes semantic consistency conflicts, factual knowledge conflicts, and project context deviations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们定义了代码翻译中的幻觉问题，并建立了一个分类体系，以区分语义一致性冲突、事实知识冲突和项目上下文偏差。

paragraphs.en: We construct a manually labeled hallucination dataset covering 13,919 cases from seven LLMs, three datasets, and six translation directions, enabling fine-grained analysis across models and language pairs.

paragraphs.en: We propose HaluCodeTran, a taxonomy-aware mitigation framework that combines retrieval-augmented examples with reflective refinement, and evaluate it against representative prompting and retrieval baselines.

paragraphs.en: Automated code translation facilitates the migration of codebases across programming languages and can reduce manual migration effort. Recently, large language models (LLMs) with hundreds of billions of parameters have demonstrated impressive capabilities across natural language and code tasks ( Hurst et al., 2024 ; Hui et al., 2024 ) . General-purpose LLMs ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; AI, 2023 ; Abdin et al., 2024 ) and code-specialized LLMs ( Roziere et al., 2023 ; Team et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2023 ; Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) have shown strong performance when trained on large code corpora, such as GPT ( Tang et al., 2024 ) , LLaMA ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen ( Hui et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) , Gemma ( Team et al., 2024b ) , DeepSeek-Coder ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , etc.

paragraphs.en: The LLM-powered code translation has achieved significant progress in recent years ( Saha et al., 2024 ; Macedo et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Shiraishi and Shinagawa, 2024 ; Tao et al., 2024 ; Dhruv and Dubey, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Jana et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Macedo et al., 2025 ) . For example, by augmenting generation with in-context learning, the code structure (e.g., Abstract Syntax Tree) knowledge is leveraged into large language models to improve understanding of cross-language semantic alignment ( Du et al., 2025 ) . Meanwhile, domain-specific fine-tuning on specialized codebases enables models to better capture niche terminology and idiomatic expressions in specific fields ( Dhruv and Dubey, 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: In the field of natural language processing (NLP), hallucination refers to the phenomenon where a language model generates content that is inconsistent with the input, semantically meaningless, or factually incorrect. With the rapid development of LLMs, research on hallucination has attracted significant attention across various domains ( Ji et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Lavrinovics et al., 2025 ; Lauscher et al., 2025 ) . In the community of AI for Software Engineering, existing investigations primarily focus on hallucinations, calibration, preference alignment, and error characteristics within code generation and completion ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Spiess et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Weyssow et al., 2026 ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ) . However, a fundamental distinction exists between code generation and code translation. While code generation requires the model to understand ambiguous natural language intents and write programs, code translation demands a rigorous understanding of structured source code and precise cross-lingual semantic mapping. This shift from “intent-to-code” to “code-to-code” alignment introduces distinct hallucination patterns, such as syntax-level interference, cross-language API mismatches, and subtle source-target semantic divergence. Existing code-hallucination studies provide useful definitions and evaluation ideas, but they do not directly answer which hallucination types dominate execution-tested code translation failures or how these types vary across source-target language pairs. Our study therefore scopes hallucination to cross-language translation and evaluates it through compiler/runtime behavior, source-target comparison, and manual taxonomy annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 在自然语言处理（NLP）领域，幻觉是指语言模型生成的内容与输入不一致、语义上无意义或事实上不正确的现象。 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，针对幻觉的研究已引起各个领域的广泛关注（Ji et al., 2023；Huang et al., 2025；Lavrinovics et al., 2025；Lauscher et al., 2025）。 在AI用于软件工程（AI for Software Engineering）社区中，现有研究主要聚焦于代码生成与代码补全中的幻觉、校准、偏好对齐以及错误特性（Liu et al., 2024；Tian et al., 2025；Spiess et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b；Weyssow et al., 2026；Zhuo et al., 2026）。 然而，代码生成与代码翻译之间存在根本性的区别。 代码生成要求模型理解模糊的自然语言意图并编写程序，而代码翻译则要求对结构化的源代码进行严谨的理解，并实现精确的跨语言语义映射。 这种从“意图到代码”到“代码到代码”的对齐转变，带来了独特的幻觉模式，例如语法层面的干扰、跨语言API不匹配以及源代码与目标代码之间细微的语义偏差。 现有的代码幻觉研究提供了有用的定义和评估思路，但它们并未直接回答哪些幻觉类型主导了经执行测试的代码翻译失败，也未回答这些类型在不同源语言—目标语言对之间如何变化。 因此，我们的研究将幻觉的范围限定于跨语言翻译，并通过编译器/运行时行为、源代码与目标代码对比以及人工分类标注来对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Recent research has extensively explored prompt engineering as a cost-effective paradigm to suppress hallucinations and improve code-generation reliability by optimizing the model’s reasoning paths and grounding its outputs in verifiable contexts ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Khojah et al., 2025 ) . First, Reasoning-guided Mitigation, exemplified by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , encourages LLMs to generate intermediate logical steps, which facilitates the decomposition of complex source code structures. However, CoT is often susceptible to “logical drifting”, where a minor hallucination in the early reasoning stage cascades into a significant functional requirement mismatch in the final translated code. Second, Self-Verification Mechanisms, such as the Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) framework ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) and recent program-analysis/backtracking strategies ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , introduce a “generate-then-verify” pipeline to rectify factual errors through independent query-answering or code-level analysis. While effective for general knowledge and some code-generation settings, these mechanisms can still fail to recognize subtle API knowledge conflicts across heterogeneous programming languages ( Zhuo et al., 2026 ) . Third, Knowledge-Augmented Approaches, particularly Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2025 ) , mitigate hallucinations by providing external “ground-truth” snippets from documentation or project-specific repositories. Despite its success in reducing project context deviations, RAG remains inherently limited by the quality of the retrieval corpus, and recent TSE evidence shows that code datasets can contain cross-dataset duplication and leakage that complicate LLM evaluation ( López et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究广泛探索了提示工程作为一种低成本的范式，通过优化模型的推理路径并将其输出置于可验证的上下文中，来抑制幻觉并提高代码生成的可靠性 ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Khojah et al., 2025 ) 。 首先，推理引导的缓解方法，以思维链（CoT）提示为代表 ( Wei et al., 2022 ) ，鼓励大语言模型生成中间逻辑步骤，从而有助于分解复杂的源代码结构。 然而，CoT 常常容易受到“逻辑漂移”的影响，即推理早期阶段出现的微小幻觉会在最终翻译的代码中级联为显著的功能需求不匹配。 其次，自我验证机制，如验证链（CoVe）框架 ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) 以及近期的程序分析/回溯策略 ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) ，引入了“先生成后验证”的流水线，通过独立的问答查询或代码级分析来纠正事实性错误。 尽管这些机制在通用知识和某些代码生成场景中有效，但它们仍可能无法识别跨异构编程语言的细微 API 知识冲突 ( Zhuo et al., 2026 ) 。 第三，知识增强方法，特别是检索增强生成（RAG） ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2025 ) ，通过提供来自文档或项目专用代码库的外部“真实”代码片段来缓解幻觉。 尽管 RAG 在减少项目上下文偏差方面取得了成功，但它本质上仍受限于检索语料库的质量，且近期的软件工程实证（TSE）证据表明，代码数据集可能包含跨数据集的重复与泄露问题，从而使大语言模型的评估更加复杂 ( López et al., 2025 ) 。

paragraphs.en: These lines of work leave two gaps for code translation. First, code translation studies primarily report end-to-end correctness metrics, but they rarely decompose failed translations into hallucination categories that explain what kind of unsupported content the model introduced. Second, hallucination mitigation methods are usually designed as generic prompting or retrieval strategies, while code translation requires feedback that is aligned with source-target semantic preservation, target-language factual knowledge, and project-context consistency. To address these gaps, our work studies hallucination phenomena in code translation and proposes a mitigation approach grounded in the observed taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究方向为代码翻译留下了两个空白。 首先，代码翻译研究主要报告端到端的正确性指标，但很少将失败的翻译分解为幻觉类别，以解释模型引入了何种不支持的内容。 其次，幻觉缓解方法通常被设计为通用的提示或检索策略，而代码翻译需要与源语言到目标语言的语义保持、目标语言的事实知识以及项目上下文一致性相匹配的反馈。 为了解决这些空白，我们的工作研究了代码翻译中的幻觉现象，并提出了一种基于所观察到的分类体系的缓解方法。

sents.en: These lines of work leave two gaps for code translation.
sents.zh: 这些研究方向为代码翻译留下了两个空白。

sents.en: First, code translation studies primarily report end-to-end correctness metrics, but they rarely decompose failed translations into hallucination categories that explain what kind of unsupported content the model introduced.
sents.zh: 首先，代码翻译研究主要报告端到端的正确性指标，但很少将失败的翻译分解为幻觉类别，以解释模型引入了何种不支持的内容。

sents.en: Second, hallucination mitigation methods are usually designed as generic prompting or retrieval strategies, while code translation requires feedback that is aligned with source-target semantic preservation, target-language factual knowledge, and project-context consistency.

sents.en: To address these gaps, our work studies hallucination phenomena in code translation and proposes a mitigation approach grounded in the observed taxonomy.
sents.zh: 为了解决这些空白，我们的工作研究了代码翻译中的幻觉现象，并提出了一种基于所观察到的分类体系的缓解方法。

paragraphs.en: We define a code-translation hallucination as a generated target-language program element that is not justified by the source program or target-language semantics and that can affect compilation, execution, maintainability, or dependency consistency. This definition separates hallucination from ordinary translation diversity. A target program is not labeled as hallucinated merely because it differs textually from the reference implementation: semantically equivalent rewrites, idiomatic target-language substitutions, and harmless formatting differences are treated as valid variants. In contrast, we label a generated fragment as hallucinated when test execution, compiler/runtime diagnostics, or manual source-target comparison shows that the fragment introduces unsupported behavior, invalid language/library knowledge, or inconsistent project context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将代码翻译幻觉定义为一种生成的目标语言程序元素，它不被源程序或目标语言语义所支持，并且可能影响编译、执行、可维护性或依赖一致性。 该定义将幻觉与普通的翻译多样性区分开来。 目标程序不会仅仅因为它在文本上与参考实现不同而被标记为幻觉：语义等价的重写、符合目标语言习惯的替换以及无害的格式差异都被视为有效的变体。 相反，当测试执行、编译器/运行时诊断或人工源代码-目标代码比对表明某个生成片段引入了不受支持的行为、无效的语言/库知识或不一致的项目上下文时，我们将该片段标记为幻觉。

paragraphs.en: To construct the taxonomy, two authors first performed open coding on LLM-generated translations from the benchmark setting described in Section 5.1 . We employ Qwen 2.5-Coder ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , DeepSeek-Coder-V2 ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , Llama 3.1 ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Gemma 2 ( Team et al., 2024b ) , Mistral ( AI, 2023 ) , Phi 4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) , and GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) on CodeNet ( Puri et al., 2021 ) , Avatar ( Ahmad et al., 2023 ) , and Transcoder ( Rozière et al., 2020 ) , covering C++ → \rightarrow Java, C++ → \rightarrow Python, Java → \rightarrow C++, Java → \rightarrow Python, Python → \rightarrow C++, and Python → \rightarrow Java. Each generated program is compiled or executed in the corresponding target-language environment. The annotators then inspect the generated code, compiler/runtime messages, source program, reference solution, and available test results to identify the concrete erroneous fragment and assign one or more hallucination labels. This process follows open-coding practice and is informed by hallucination taxonomies from natural-language and code-generation studies ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Tian et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建该分类体系，两位作者首先对 5.1 节所述基准设置下的大语言模型生成译文进行了开放编码。 我们在 CodeNet（Puri et al., 2021）、Avatar（Ahmad et al., 2023）和 Transcoder（Rozière et al., 2020）上采用了 Qwen 2.5-Coder（Yang et al., 2024a）、DeepSeek-Coder-V2（Zhu et al., 2024）、Llama 3.1（Grattafiori et al., 2024）、Gemma 2（Team et al., 2024b）、Mistral（AI, 2023）、Phi 4（Abdin et al., 2024）和 GPT-4o（Hurst et al., 2024），涵盖 C++ → \rightarrow Java、C++ → \rightarrow Python、Java → \rightarrow C++、Java → \rightarrow Python、Python → \rightarrow C++ 和 Python → \rightarrow Java。 每个生成的程序都会在相应的目标语言环境中进行编译或执行。 标注者随后检查生成的代码、编译器/运行时消息、源程序、参考解答以及可用的测试结果，以确定具体的错误片段并赋予一个或多个幻觉标签。 这一过程遵循开放编码的实践，并参考了自然语言与代码生成研究中的幻觉分类体系（Zhang et al., 2024b；Tian et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The annotation protocol is multi-label because a single failed translation can contain more than one hallucinated fragment or one fragment can exhibit multiple failure modes. For example, an undefined function call can simultaneously reflect identifier confusion and dependency conflict if the call is inconsistent with both local scope and required imports. When annotators encounter a case not covered by the current codebook, they record the evidence, propose a provisional label, and discuss whether the case should be merged into an existing category or used to refine the taxonomy. Disagreements are resolved through joint inspection of the source program, generated program, execution result, and category definition.
paragraphs.zh: 标注协议采用多标签形式，因为单个失败的翻译可能包含多个幻觉片段，或者同一片段可能表现出多种失败模式。 例如，一个未定义的函数调用可能同时反映标识符混淆和依赖冲突，因为该调用既与局部作用域不一致，也与所需导入不一致。 当标注者遇到当前编码手册未涵盖的情况时，他们会记录证据、提出临时标签，并讨论该情况应归并入现有类别，还是用于完善分类体系。 分歧通过共同审查源程序、生成程序、执行结果和类别定义来解决。

sents.en: Figure 1 summarizes the resulting taxonomy.

paragraphs.en: Semantic consistency conflicts occur when the translated code fails to preserve the intended behavior or semantics of the source code.
paragraphs.zh: 当翻译后的代码未能保留源代码的预期行为或语义时，就会发生语义一致性冲突。

paragraphs.en: Functional requirement mismatch refers to the generated code diverging from the intended logic or functional requirements. As shown in Figure 2 ( 2(a) ), the source C++ code has a conditional judgment if ( time < s [ j ]) , which means that when time is less than s [ j ] , the value of time should be updated to s [ j ] . However, the generated Python code wrongly writes the condition as if time > s [ j ] . This incorrect logical condition is a misinterpretation of the original code’s intention, deviating from the correct logic that the source code wants to implement, thus resulting in a logical error.
paragraphs.zh: 功能需求不匹配是指生成的代码偏离了预期的逻辑或功能需求。 如图2（2(a)）所示，源C++代码中有一个条件判断 if ( time < s [ j ])，意思是当 time 小于 s [ j ] 时，应将 time 的值更新为 s [ j ]。 然而，生成的Python代码错误地将条件写成了 if time > s [ j ]。 这一错误的逻辑条件是对原代码意图的误解，偏离了源代码想要实现的正确逻辑，从而导致逻辑错误。

paragraphs.en: Data consistency violation occurs when variables, inputs, or outputs become inconsistent during translation. As shown in Figure 2 ( 2(b) ), the LLM misuses multiple assignments by incorrectly incorporating the augmented assignment sum += num [ i ] * m [ i ] into a multiple-assignment statement. The augmented assignment is not valid as the left-hand side of the multiple assignment must be a legitimate assignable target, and sum += num [ i ] * m [ i ] does not meet this requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 当变量、输入或输出在翻译过程中变得不一致时，就会发生数据一致性违规。 如图 2（2(b)）所示，大语言模型错误地使用多重赋值，将增量赋值 sum += num [ i ] * m [ i ] 不正确地纳入一条多重赋值语句中。 该增量赋值是无效的，因为多重赋值的左侧必须是一个合法的可赋值目标，而 sum += num [ i ] * m [ i ] 不满足这一要求。

paragraphs.en: Factual knowledge conflicts arise when the translated code violates the basic syntax or demonstrates misunderstandings of libraries or APIs because of the limitations of the knowledge of the corresponding programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 当翻译后的代码违反基本语法，或由于对相应编程语言知识的局限性而表现出对库或 API 的误解时，就会产生事实性知识冲突。

paragraphs.en: Basic Syntax Conflicts involve syntax-related errors that render the translated code incorrect or uncompileable. In the Figure 2 ( 2(c) ), in Python code, a colon is required at the end of the for loop header to denote the start of the loop body. However, the generated code has for _ in range ( n ) without the necessary colon, leading to a SyntaxError as the interpreter expects a colon to properly structure the statement.
paragraphs.zh: 基础语法冲突涉及与语法相关的错误，这些错误会导致翻译后的代码不正确或无法编译。 在图2（2(c)）中，Python 代码的 for 循环头部末尾需要一个冒号，以标示循环体的开始。 然而，生成的代码是 for _ in range ( n )，缺少必要的冒号，导致解释器在期望冒号来正确构建该语句时抛出 SyntaxError。

paragraphs.en: Library knowledge conflicts occur when the translation uses incorrect or non-existent standard or third-party libraries. As shown in Figure 2 ( 2(d) ), there is no standard module called vector in Python, yet the code generation wrongly assumes its existence and tries to import it, mimicking the #include < vector > statement from the C++ source code. This is a clear case of the code generation tool generating incorrect code based on a misinterpretation or over-generalization of the source code’s library inclusion mechanism, failing to account for the differences in module availability between C++ and Python.
paragraphs.zh: 库知识冲突发生在翻译使用了错误或不存在的标准库或第三方库时。 如图 2（2(d)）所示，Python 中并不存在名为 vector 的标准模块，但代码生成却错误地假设其存在并尝试导入它，模仿了 C++ 源代码中的 #include < vector > 语句。 这是一个典型的案例：代码生成工具基于对源代码库引入机制的误解或过度泛化而生成了错误的代码，未能考虑 C++ 与 Python 之间模块可用性的差异。

paragraphs.en: API knowledge conflicts involve incorrect usage of APIs, including function names, parameters, or control logic. As shown in Figure 2 ( 2(e) ), the generated code attempts to directly pass a numerical result ( n - 2) * 180 to sys . stdout . write () , ignoring the fact that this function only accepts strings. This is a misinterpretation of how output operations work in the API of Python.

paragraphs.en: Repetition or dead code issues include unnecessary or unreachable code introduced in translation. paragraphs.en: Identifier & function confusion refers to hallucinations where the generated code misuses variables, functions, or instances that are defined within the local project context (rather than external APIs). These errors often indicate a failure to track or understand in-project definitions, scopes, or naming. As shown in Figure 2 ( 2(h) ), the generated code attempts to call LLI ( n ) while the function LLI is defined to take no positional arguments. This misinterpretation of the function’s parameter requirements leads to a runtime error stating that “ LLI () takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given”. It shows that the code generation process has an incorrect understanding of how the function should be called, creating an inconsistent and erroneous implementation compared to the intended logic.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符与函数混淆是指生成的代码误用了本地项目上下文中定义的变量、函数或实例（而非外部 API）的幻觉。 这类错误通常表明模型未能正确跟踪或理解项目内的定义、作用域或命名。 如图 2（2(h)）所示，生成的代码试图调用 LLI ( n )，而函数 LLI 的定义不接受任何位置参数。 这种对函数参数要求的错误理解导致了运行时错误，提示“LLI () takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given”。 这表明代码生成过程对函数应如何被调用存在错误理解，相较于预期逻辑产生了不一致且错误的实现。

paragraphs.en: For each dataset and translation direction, we use the official source programs and available test cases to evaluate generated target programs. A generated program is counted as compilable only when it passes the target-language compilation or syntax-checking stage without manual repair. A generated program is counted as computationally correct only when it produces the same outputs as the reference program on the provided test suite. We do not use test outputs, reference explanations, or ground-truth target code as feedback to the LLM during vanilla translation or reflective refinement; these artifacts are used only for offline evaluation and annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个数据集和翻译方向，我们使用官方源程序及可用的测试用例来评估生成的目标程序。 只有当生成的程序在无需人工修复的情况下通过目标语言的编译或语法检查阶段时，才将其计为可编译。 只有当生成的程序在提供的测试套件上产生与参考程序相同的输出时，才将其计为计算正确。 在普通翻译或反思式细化过程中，我们不使用测试输出、参考解释或真实目标代码作为给大语言模型（LLM）的反馈；这些产物仅用于离线评估和标注。

paragraphs.en: This RQ establishes the foundational baseline for the entire empirical study, which is essential for objectively measuring the native code translation capabilities of state-of-the-art LLMs via core metrics like CSR and CA. It quantifies performance disparities across models and language pairs, and provides a measurable reference for attributing unsatisfactory translation results to hallucination issues, laying the empirical groundwork for all subsequent hallucination-related analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究问题为整个实证研究奠定了基础基线，这对于通过 CSR 和 CA 等核心指标客观衡量最先进大语言模型的原生代码翻译能力至关重要。 它量化了不同模型与语言对之间的性能差异，并为将不理想的翻译结果归因于幻觉问题提供了可度量的参考，为后续所有与幻觉相关的分析奠定了实证基础。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the computation accuracy of code translation across three datasets (CodeNet, Transcoder, and Avatar) using seven state-of-the-art LLMs. We report the percentage of successful translations for each source-target language pair, with success measured by functional equivalence. paragraphs.en: In contrast, models such as Llama 3.1 ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Gemma 2 ( Team et al., 2024b ) , and Mistral ( AI, 2023 ) show lower computation accuracy, particularly on the Avatar dataset. Mistral, for instance, only achieves 18.90% average on Avatar, indicating its limited ability to generalize to real-world, less-structured codebases. A closer look at the direction-specific results reveals that translations involving Python as the target language tend to be more challenging. For instance, on CodeNet, the C++ → \rightarrow Python and Java → \rightarrow Python tasks yield consistently lower computation accuracy across models. Conversely, translations between syntactically similar languages, such as C++ and Java, generally yield higher computation accuracy. The Transcoder dataset yields overall higher computation accuracy, likely due to its more controlled and balanced nature, while the Avatar dataset proves the most difficult, reflecting the challenges of handling diverse and noisy code from real repositories. These findings suggest that while recent LLMs show promising translation capabilities, there remains a performance gap between models and datasets. The poor performance is largely due to the hallucinations generated by the model during code translation. Therefore, in the next section, we conduct an in-depth quantitative and qualitative analysis of hallucination phenomena across different models, datasets, and language pairs, aiming to answer how hallucinations are distributed and which types of hallucinations dominate LLM-based code translation failures.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 presents the hallucination distribution of the seven evaluated LLMs across datasets. Overall, Mistral consistently exhibits the highest hallucination counts across most translation directions, with a relatively high rate of API Knowledge Conflicts (AKC), suggesting a tendency to hallucinate or misuse APIs even when general syntax and structure are preserved. In contrast, GPT-4o exhibits the lowest overall hallucination rate, demonstrating strong reliability across translation pairs. However, its performance is primarily constrained by Semantic Consistency Conflicts, indicating that while GPT-4o excels in factual correctness and context consistency, it occasionally struggles to preserve the intended behavior or semantics of the source code. DeepSeek-Coder ranks second only to GPT-4o in minimizing hallucinations, demonstrating strong generalization across a range of translation tasks. It is closely followed by Qwen 2.5-coder and Phi 4, both of which exhibit relatively stable performance, though with slightly greater fluctuations across hallucination types, particularly in categories related to project context and factual knowledge. Gemma 2 exhibits relatively strong performance on the C++ to Python translation task, with a noticeably lower number of hallucinations compared to other language pairs. This indicates that Gemma 2 is particularly well-suited for conversions between C++ and Python, potentially due to more effective pattern alignment or training exposure in these languages. While LLaMA 3.1 shows weaker performance overall, it achieves competitive results in the C++ to Java translation task, suggesting that its strengths may be more pronounced in specific language pairs or syntactic structures.

paragraphs.en: This section addresses the critical gap in existing literature regarding code translation hallucination mitigation frameworks and serves as the primary application-oriented inquiry of this study. Synthesizing our previous analysis of hallucination taxonomies and the limitations of static methodologies, we investigate the inherent reflection capabilities of LLMs. Specifically, we propose a new approach termed HaluCodeTran, which leverages retrieval-augmentation to supplement LLMs with relevant code translation knowledge and a reflective iterative refinement strategy to identify and correct errors. In the following sections, we describe the technical details of baseline methods and HaluCodeTran and the quantitative experiments on hallucination mitigation.

paragraphs.en: 1) Knowledge Augmentation via Contextual Grounding. The execution begins with the acquisition of the input source code x x . To mitigate potential hallucinations arising from cross-language mapping ambiguities, we first perform knowledge augmentation. Specifically, we leverage a demonstrated knowledge base 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , containing high-quality pairs of source and target code. Following established practices ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , we adopt the BM25 algorithm ( Robertson et al., 2009 ) to retrieve a subset of relevant examples 𝒮 \mathcal{S} based on their lexical and structural relevance scores to x x . These examples 𝒮 \mathcal{S} act as a repository of implicit knowledge , encompassing target language syntax, library usage, and idiomatic conversion patterns. By providing these grounded references, we effectively narrow the model’s search space and provide a pedagogical basis for the subsequent translation.

paragraphs.en: 3) Recursive Self-Reflection and Refinement. To systematically rectify these hallucinations, HaluCodeTran enters a recursive self-reflection loop. In each iteration i i , the model receives four inputs: the source program x x , the current translation y ^ i \hat{y}^{i} , the retrieved examples 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , and the taxonomy definitions in Section 3.1 – 3.3 . It then produces a reflection report ℛ i \mathcal{R}^{i} that checks whether y ^ i \hat{y}^{i} preserves source-program behavior, uses valid target-language syntax and APIs, and avoids project-context deviations. Unlike an execution-based repair loop, this reflection step does not observe hidden test results; it relies only on the source code, retrieved examples, and taxonomy-guided inspection. If the reflection report does not identify any taxonomy category, IsConsistent ​ ( ℛ i ) \text{IsConsistent}(\mathcal{R}^{i}) returns true and the process terminates. Otherwise, the model distills a structured critique 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}^{i} from the report. paragraphs.en: We perform a series of experiments to validate whether we can guide LLMs to alleviate hallucinations via prompt engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一系列实验，以验证能否通过提示工程引导大语言模型缓解幻觉。

paragraphs.en: Vanilla: is the standalone LLM without any additional preprocessing modules or external retrievers. Vanilla LLMs represent the original capabilities of LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: Vanilla：指没有任何额外预处理模块或外部检索器的独立LLM。 Vanilla LLM 代表了LLM的原始能力。

sents.en: Vanilla: is the standalone LLM without any additional preprocessing modules or external retrievers.
sents.zh: Vanilla：指没有任何额外预处理模块或外部检索器的独立LLM。

sents.en: Vanilla LLMs represent the original capabilities of LLMs.
sents.zh: Vanilla LLM 代表了LLM的原始能力。

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-Thought(CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) : is a prompting technique to encourage multi-step reasoning by explicitly guiding the LLMs to "think" step-by-step before answering.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）（Wei et al., 2022）：是一种提示技术，通过显式引导大语言模型在回答前逐步“思考”，来鼓励其进行多步推理。

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-Verification(CoVe) ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) : prompts LLMs to draft the initial response, plan verification questions, answer the question, and generate the final verified response.
paragraphs.zh: 验证链（Chain-of-Verification, CoVe）（Dhuliawala et al., 2024）：提示大语言模型起草初始回答、规划验证问题、回答这些问题，并生成最终经验证的回答。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmentation(RA): following the widely-used setting ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , uses LLMs with the BM25 algorithm ( Robertson et al., 2009 ) to retrieve the most relevant texts as input to vanilla LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强（RA）：遵循广泛使用的设置（Zhao et al., 2023），使用大语言模型结合 BM25 算法（Robertson et al., 2009）检索最相关的文本作为原始大语言模型的输入。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate hallucination mitigation on CodeNet because it provides balanced language-pair coverage and executable test cases for all six translation directions. For each evaluated model, we construct a retrieval database from source programs and their successfully translated target programs in the model’s successful pool. The evaluation set contains the remaining source programs that were not successfully translated by the same model under the vanilla setting. During retrieval, the query program itself is excluded from the candidate pool, and the model receives only retrieved source-target examples rather than test outputs or reference explanations. This setting evaluates whether a mitigation method can repair cases that are difficult for the original model while avoiding direct test-feedback repair. For the Retrieval-Augmentation baseline, the 5-shot setting is chosen based on its superior performance in preliminary experiments. To ensure fairness, we also apply the same 5-shot retrieved context in the initial translation phase of HaluCodeTran. CoT, CoVe, RA, and HaluCodeTran are evaluated on the same per-model test split, using the same base model and the same execution-based CA metric.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 CodeNet 上评估幻觉缓解方法，因为它提供了均衡的语言对覆盖，并且为所有六个翻译方向提供了可执行的测试用例。 对于每个被评估的模型，我们使用该模型成功池中的源程序及其成功翻译得到的目标程序来构建检索数据库。 评估集包含在原始设置下未被同一模型成功翻译的其余源程序。 在检索过程中，查询程序本身会从候选池中排除，模型只会收到检索到的源-目标示例，而不是测试输出或参考解释。 该设置评估的是：缓解方法能否在避免直接使用测试反馈修复的情况下，修复对原始模型而言较为困难的案例。 对于检索增强基线，选择 5-shot 设置是基于其在初步实验中的更优表现。 为确保公平，我们也在 HaluCodeTran 的初始翻译阶段应用相同的 5-shot 检索上下文。 CoT、CoVe、RA 和 HaluCodeTran 在相同的每模型测试划分上进行评估，使用相同的基础模型和相同的基于执行的 CA 指标。

paragraphs.en: We compare HaluCodeTran with representative prompt-based and retrieval-based mitigation methods, including CoT, CoVe, and RA, across models and language pairs. paragraphs.en: Table 3 presents the code translation performance of different hallucination mitigation techniques across three models (Llama 3.1, Gemma 2, Mistral) on the CodeNet dataset. Regarding the experimental results, three key findings can be summarized as follows. First, all mitigation methods improve average CA over vanilla translation for the three evaluated models. Mistral, which has the weakest vanilla performance on CodeNet, improves from 33.58% to 50.33% under HaluCodeTran. Llama 3.1 improves from 48.00% to 61.08%, and Gemma 2 improves from 54.25% to 64.83%. These results indicate that contextual prompting and refinement can partially compensate for weak base translation capability, especially for smaller general-purpose models.
paragraphs.zh: 表3展示了三种模型（Llama 3.1、Gemma 2、Mistral）在CodeNet数据集上采用不同幻觉缓解技术的代码翻译性能。 关于实验结果，可以总结出以下三点关键发现。 首先，对于所评估的三个模型，所有缓解方法都使平均CA高于原始翻译。 Mistral在CodeNet上的原始性能最弱，在HaluCodeTran下从33.58%提升到50.33%。 Llama 3.1从48.00%提升到61.08%，Gemma 2从54.25%提升到64.83%。 这些结果表明，上下文提示与精炼可以在部分程度上弥补较弱的基础翻译能力，对于较小的通用模型尤其如此。

paragraphs.en: Second, the three baseline mitigation strategies show different strengths. CoT is the strongest non-HaluCodeTran baseline for Gemma 2 on average, improving CA by 8.67 percentage points over vanilla and matching the best result on Python → \rightarrow Java. CoVe is the strongest non-HaluCodeTran baseline for Llama 3.1, with a 10.42 percentage-point average gain and the largest baseline gain on C++ → \rightarrow Python. RA is particularly effective for Mistral, improving average CA by 14.50 percentage points and achieving a 22.00 percentage-point gain on Python → \rightarrow C++. These differences show that reasoning, verification, and retrieval address different parts of the code-translation failure surface, but no single generic baseline dominates across all models and language pairs.

paragraphs.en: This subsection is the key to conducting a fine-grained and in-depth evaluation of hallucination mitigation strategies, which complements the macro performance evaluation of subsection 6.3. paragraphs.en: To provide a comprehensive understanding of hallucination behaviors, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of how different mitigation strategies affect various types of hallucinations across multiple models on the CodeNet dataset (Table 4 and Figure 5 ). Across all models, HaluCodeTran demonstrates the most robust mitigation effect, achieving the largest average reduction in total hallucinations: 29% for Llama 3.1, 32% for Gemma 2, and 32% for Mistral. Regarding Factual Knowledge Conflicts, especially in subtypes such as API Knowledge Conflicts (AKC) and Library Knowledge Conflicts (LKC), HaluCodeTran leads across all models; e.g., HaluCodeTran achieves a consistent reduction in AKC hallucinations across all three models (11% reduction on Gemma 2, 24% on Llama 3.1, 38% on Mistral), indicating its strength in correcting incorrect or hallucinated API calls and exception handling. Regarding Project Context Deviations, HaluCodeTran exhibits superior performance in mitigating Identifier & Function Confusion (IFC) hallucinations, with the most significant reduction rates among all methods (49% on Gemma 2, 30% on Llama 3.1, 28% on Mistral), demonstrating its ability to effectively address context deviations and inconsistent logical flow in translated code.
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面理解幻觉行为，我们在 CodeNet 数据集（表 4 和图 5）上对不同缓解策略如何影响多个模型中的各类幻觉进行了细粒度分析。 在所有模型中，HaluCodeTran 展现出最稳健的缓解效果，在总幻觉方面实现了最大的平均降幅：Llama 3.1 上为 29%，Gemma 2 上为 32%，Mistral 上为 32%。 在事实知识冲突方面，尤其是 API 知识冲突（AKC）和库知识冲突（LKC）等子类型上，HaluCodeTran 在所有模型中均处于领先地位；例如，HaluCodeTran 在所有三个模型上都实现了 AKC 幻觉的持续下降（Gemma 2 上降低 11%，Llama 3.1 上降低 24%，Mistral 上降低 38%），表明其在纠正错误或幻觉式 API 调用与异常处理方面的优势。 在项目上下文偏差方面，HaluCodeTran 在缓解标识符与函数混淆（IFC）幻觉方面表现卓越，在所有方法中降幅最为显著（Gemma 2 上为 49%，Llama 3.1 上为 30%，Mistral 上为 28%），证明了其有效解决翻译代码中上下文偏差和逻辑流程不一致问题的能力。

paragraphs.en: The main internal validity threat comes from manual annotation. Code-translation hallucinations can be multi-faceted, and annotators may disagree about whether an erroneous fragment should be labeled as a semantic conflict, factual conflict, project-context deviation, or multiple categories. To mitigate this threat, two annotators with extensive Java, C++, and Python experience independently inspected the generated program, source program, execution result, compiler/runtime diagnostic, and reference solution before adjudication. A remaining limitation is that manual labeling still depends on human judgment, especially for semantically equivalent rewrites that differ substantially from the reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的内部效度威胁来自人工标注。 代码翻译中的幻觉可能是多方面的，标注者对于一个错误片段应被标记为语义冲突、事实冲突、项目上下文偏差还是多个类别可能存在分歧。 为缓解这一威胁，两位具有丰富 Java、C++ 和 Python 经验的标注者在裁决之前独立检查了生成的程序、源程序、执行结果、编译器/运行时诊断信息以及参考解答。 剩余的局限在于，人工标注仍然依赖人的判断，尤其是对于与参考实现差异较大但在语义上等价的重写。

paragraphs.en: Another internal validity threat is potential information leakage in retrieval-based mitigation. Because CodeNet, Avatar, and Transcoder contain many structurally similar programming tasks, a retrieval method may obtain examples that are too close to the evaluation query. We reduce this risk by excluding the query program from the retrieval candidate set and by evaluating all mitigation methods on the same per-model test split. Nevertheless, near-duplicate problems or same-family solutions may still inflate retrieval-based methods. We therefore treat the mitigation results as evidence of practical repair capability under the benchmark setting, rather than as proof that the framework fully generalizes to unseen project domains.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个内部效度威胁是基于检索的缓解措施中潜在的信息泄露。 由于 CodeNet、Avatar 和 Transcoder 包含许多结构相似的编程任务，检索方法可能获得与评测查询过于接近的示例。 我们通过从检索候选集中排除查询程序，并在相同的按模型测试划分上评估所有缓解方法来降低这一风险。 尽管如此，近乎重复的问题或同族的解法仍可能夸大基于检索的方法的效果。 因此，我们将缓解结果视为基准设置下实际修复能力的证据，而非证明该框架能完全泛化到未见过的项目领域。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity is affected by the definition of hallucination. This work labels generated fragments as hallucinated when they introduce unsupported semantics, invalid language/library knowledge, or inconsistent project context. This definition is broader than factual hallucination in natural-language generation and overlaps with some categories of code translation error. We adopt the broader definition because code translation failures are often observable only through compilation, execution, and source-target semantic comparison. However, the taxonomy may not cover all edge cases, such as performance-only regressions, security-specific vulnerabilities, or errors that require whole-project context beyond the benchmark snippet.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度会受到幻觉定义的影响。 本工作在生成的代码片段引入了缺乏依据的语义、无效的语言/库知识或不一致的项目上下文时，将其标注为幻觉。 该定义比自然语言生成中的事实幻觉更宽泛，并与某些类别的代码翻译错误相重叠。 我们采用这一更宽泛的定义，因为代码翻译失败往往只能通过编译、执行以及源代码与目标代码的语义比较才能观察到。 然而，该分类法可能无法覆盖所有边界情况，例如仅涉及性能的退化、特定于安全的漏洞，或需要超出基准代码片段的整个项目上下文才能发现的错误。

paragraphs.en: External validity concerns the choice of languages, datasets, and models. Our study focuses on Java, C++, and Python over CodeNet, Avatar, and Transcoder, which are widely used but still do not represent all migration scenarios. Results may differ for less common languages, domain-specific frameworks, multi-file projects, or tasks requiring build-system migration. Model validity is also time-sensitive: we evaluate seven representative LLMs, including GPT-4o and open-source models, but newer models and specialized code agents may exhibit different hallucination patterns. Reproducibility is limited by model nondeterminism and closed-model availability. Even with fixed prompts and decoding configurations, proprietary APIs may change over time, and stochastic decoding can alter generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度涉及语言、数据集和模型的选择。 我们的研究聚焦于 CodeNet、Avatar 和 Transcoder 上的 Java、C++ 和 Python，这些数据集被广泛使用，但仍不能代表所有迁移场景。 对于较不常见的语言、特定领域的框架、多文件项目或需要构建系统迁移的任务，结果可能有所不同。 模型效度也具有时间敏感性：我们评估了七个具有代表性的大语言模型，包括 GPT-4o 和开源模型，但更新的模型和专门的代码智能体可能表现出不同的幻觉模式。 可复现性受限于模型的非确定性和闭源模型的可用性。 即使使用固定的提示词和解码配置，专有 API 也可能随时间变化，且随机解码可能改变生成的代码。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents an empirical study of hallucinations in LLM-powered code translation. Through thematic analysis and manual annotation of 13,919 hallucination cases across seven LLMs, three benchmark datasets, and six language pairs, we establish a taxonomy that separates semantic consistency conflicts, factual knowledge conflicts, and project context deviations. Based on the taxonomy, we propose HaluCodeTran, a mitigation framework that integrates retrieval-augmented examples with iterative reflective refinement. Experiments on CodeNet show that HaluCodeTran improves computational accuracy and reduces hallucination cases compared with representative prompting and retrieval baselines. These findings suggest that code-translation hallucination should be studied not only as a correctness failure, but also as a structured source of semantic, factual, and contextual error signals. In future work, we plan to extend the taxonomy to multi-file migration scenarios, strengthen automated hallucination detection, and study training or alignment strategies that reduce hallucinations before inference-time repair is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 本文对基于大语言模型的代码翻译中的幻觉现象进行了一项实证研究。 通过对七个大语言模型、三个基准数据集和六种语言对之间共计 13,919 个幻觉案例进行主题分析与人工标注，我们建立了一个分类体系，将语义一致性冲突、事实性知识冲突和项目上下文偏差区分开来。 基于该分类体系，我们提出了 HaluCodeTran，一个将检索增强示例与迭代反思式精化相结合的缓解框架。 在 CodeNet 上的实验表明，与具有代表性的提示和检索基线相比，HaluCodeTran 提升了计算准确性并减少了幻觉案例。 这些发现表明，代码翻译幻觉不仅应被视为一种正确性失败，还应被视为语义、事实和上下文错误信号的结构化来源。 在未来工作中，我们计划将该分类体系扩展到多文件迁移场景，加强自动化幻觉检测，并研究能够在推理时修复之前就减少幻觉的训练或对齐策略。
